package bodyless_test

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json/jsontext"
	"encoding/json/v2"
	"errors"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	svc "example.com/bodyless/gen/bodyless"
	common "example.com/bodyless/gen/common"
	server "example.com/bodyless/gen/jsonrpc/bodyless/server"
	loomhttp "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/http"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

func TestBodylessResponses(t *testing.T) {
	for _, method := range []string{"local", "local_bare", "moved", "moved_bare", "nothing", "value", "metadata"} {
		for _, mode := range []string{"success", "error", "notification"} {
			t.Run(method+"/"+mode, func(t *testing.T) {
				calls, encodes, handled := 0, 0, 0
				endpoint := func(context.Context, any) (any, error) {
					calls++
					if mode == "error" {
						return nil, errors.New("private endpoint error")
					}
					switch method {
					case "local", "local_bare":
						return &svc.LocalEmpty{}, nil
					case "moved", "moved_bare":
						return &common.MovedEmpty{}, nil
					case "value":
						return "value", nil
					case "metadata":
						return &svc.MetadataResult{Header: "header", Cookie: "cookie"}, nil
					default:
						return nil, nil
					}
				}
				endpoints := &svc.Endpoints{Local: endpoint, LocalBare: endpoint, Moved: endpoint, MovedBare: endpoint, Nothing: endpoint, Value: endpoint, Metadata: endpoint}
				mux := loomhttp.NewMuxer()
				encoder := func(ctx context.Context, w http.ResponseWriter) loomhttp.Encoder {
					encodes++
					return loomhttp.ResponseEncoder(ctx, w)
				}
				handler := server.New(endpoints, mux, loomhttp.RequestDecoder, encoder, func(context.Context, http.ResponseWriter, error) {
					handled++
				})
				server.Mount(mux, handler)
				id := `,"id":1`
				if mode == "notification" {
					id = ""
				}
				request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/rpc", strings.NewReader(`{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"`+method+`"`+id+`}`))
				request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
				response := httptest.NewRecorder()
				mux.ServeHTTP(response, request)
				require.Equal(t, 1, calls)
				require.Zero(t, handled)
				if mode == "notification" {
					require.Equal(t, http.StatusOK, response.Code)
					require.Empty(t, response.Body.String())
					require.Zero(t, encodes)
					require.Empty(t, response.Header().Get("X-Result"))
					return
				}
				require.Equal(t, http.StatusOK, response.Code)
				var envelope map[string]jsontext.Value
				require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(response.Body.Bytes(), &envelope))
				require.JSONEq(t, "1", string(envelope["id"]))
				if mode == "error" {
					require.NotEmpty(t, envelope["error"])
					var failure struct {
						Code int `json:"code"`
					}
					require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(envelope["error"], &failure))
					require.Equal(t, -32603, failure.Code)
					require.NotContains(t, response.Body.String(), "private endpoint error")
					require.NotContains(t, envelope, "result")
					require.Equal(t, 1, encodes)
					return
				}
				require.NotContains(t, envelope, "error")
				want := "null"
				if method == "value" {
					want = `"value"`
				}
				require.JSONEq(t, want, string(envelope["result"]))
				if method == "metadata" {
					require.Equal(t, "header", response.Header().Get("X-Result"))
					require.Contains(t, response.Header().Get("Set-Cookie"), "result=cookie")
					require.Equal(t, 1, encodes)
				} else {
					require.Equal(t, 1, encodes)
				}
			})
		}
	}
}
